rows.en: The target has broken through the combat zone.
The target broke through the combat zone.
Thanks to your clumsiness, the target broke through!
The target has broken through the zone!
rows.notes: Transcript has senyaku (war service); surely sen-iki (combat zone), as the other operators say.

rows.en: Target broke through the combat zone.
The target has begun to withdraw. Destroy it before it breaks through the zone.
Target's started withdrawing. Destroy it before it breaks through the zone.
The target's trying to run. Don't let it!
Target withdrawing. Destroy it before it breaks out of the zone.
The enemy is trying to leave the combat zone. Join the pursuit too.
The target has begun to withdraw. Please shoot it down if you possibly can.
rows.notes: Kanou na kagiri could cover several targets ("as many as possible"); read as the one target, matching Pinon's and Misa's lines.

rows.en: The target's started withdrawing. Take it down if you can.
Take down the fleeing target. Well, only if you can manage it.
Target withdrawing. Shoot it down if you possibly can.
The enemy is retreating. If we can, I'd like to thin out their forces.
Target still alive. At this rate it'll break through.
rows.notes: Transcript has kensa (inspection); surely kenzai (still alive), as the other operators say.

rows.en: Target still alive. Its escape is only a matter of time.
The target's still alive. It's obvious it'll escape at this rate.
rows.notes: Transcript has yaruki da ze (feeling motivated); probably kenzai da ze (still alive).

rows.en: Target still alive. At this rate it'll break through!
rows.notes: Transcript writes kenzai (visible) with the wrong kanji; kenzai (alive).

rows.en: The enemy is intact. It will leave the zone shortly.
The target has left the combat zone.
The target left the combat zone.
Aaah, we lost the target!
The target has left the combat zone.
Target left the combat zone.
We've lost the target.
We've lost the target.
The target ran out of the combat zone!
Target lost.
Target lost from radar.
Target gone. We can't track it.
Target left the combat zone. Can't track it.
Aaah, we lost the target!
Target gone. Can't track it.
Target has left. We can't track it.
Please destroy the target before it reaches the objective area.
rows.notes: Transcript has mokuhyo-ire (target container); surely mokuhyo eria (objective area).

rows.en: Destroy the target before it reaches the objective area.
Don't let the target reach the objective area. Destroy it!
Destroy the target before it reaches the objective area!
Destroy the target before it reaches the objective area.
The target is approaching the objective area.
The target is going to reach the objective area!
Destroy it quick, or the target will get to the objective area!
Target approaching the objective area.
The target is approaching the objective area.
The target has entered the objective area.
The target has reached the objective area.
You're useless! You can't even stop the target getting in!
The target has entered the objective area!
Target has broken through the defense line.
The defense target has entered the operation area.
rows.notes: Transcript says sakusei (creation) area; surely sakusen (operation) area.

rows.en: Defense target entered the zone.
The defense target's here! Show me you can protect it!
Defense target in the operation area.
Defense target has appeared. Escort it!
Please escort the defense target.
Escort the defense target.
rows.notes: Transcript is "regarding the escort of the defense target"; read as a short order to take up escort.

rows.en: Escort the target that just arrived.
Escort the defense target.
See it? That's the defense target!
Defense target confirmed.
Defense target confirmed. Protect it.
That's the defense target. Defend it!
Defense target confirmed.
Defense target confirmed. Move to escort.
Please escort the defense target.
Escort it so enemies can't destroy it.
Defend that target!
Escort the defense target.
Keep enemies off the defense target!
Please keep the enemy away.
Escort duty is top priority.
Just keep the enemy away from the target.
Keep the enemy away!
Please escort the defense target.
The defense target is under attack.
The defense target is under enemy fire.
Hey, the defense target's under attack!
The defense target is under attack!
The defense target is under enemy attack.
